battle.name: 赤眉軍起義
battle.brief: 公元17年（天鳳四年）秋，新莽末年饑荒蔓延，泰山、琅邪的赤眉眾揭竿而起，樊俊、董封各聚數萬人，與汝南劉縉、北海王匡、宗室劉玄所舉之兵互相應和，後合兵入洛陽、叩長安。赤眉另立宗室劉盆子為帝，帶著流民入關，縱火焚燒宮室；劉秀、鄧禹、吳漢等追之，公元27年赤眉主力在宜陽、湖城一線崩潰，餘眾東走陳留、沛國而散。卡面秦弩未必隨軍而至，但新莽軍與赤眉手中的弩，正是東漢初年攻守兩端同樣倚重的一件兵器。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 赤眉軍起義是漢末新朝崩解過程中一場規模最大的農民戰爭，交戰的兩大陣營都出自同一套郡縣軍事系統的裂縫。新朝一方是王莽於公元9年建立的新政權：全國分十三州、置郡縣，州牧與太守權力交錯，軍隊由郡國精兵、邊軍、屯田兵與臨時徵發的「天下兵」拼成，器械由官府鑄造、弩機與箭鏃各郡自備，糧秣靠加賦與徵發。起義一方最初並不是一支大軍，而是公元17年（天鳳四年）在泰山郡、琅邪郡先後爆發的赤眉眾，首領為樊俊、董封，各領渠帥、聚眾數千至數萬，因染紅眉髮作記號而得名；同年汝南太守劉縉、北海郡太守王匡與宗室劉玄亦舉兵，與赤眉互相應和，後合稱「玄、赤眉」。此後起義軍以漢室宗親為旗號：劉玄於宛稱帝改元更始，赤眉則在關中另立劉盆子為帝，兩軍時合時分，主導權屢屢相爭。與此同時，劉秀等地方統帥在河北、荊州、南陽各據一方，以平亂為名收攏流民與散兵，終成平定赤眉的主力。戰局至公元27年，赤眉主力在宜陽、湖城被吳漢追殲，餘部在陳留、沛國一線潰散；新朝留下的軍政解體與新莽覆亡的戰果，最後都落在劉秀一方。
countriesEn: The Red Eyebrows rising was the largest peasant war of the collapse of the Han in the early third century, and both of the great camps in it grew out of cracks in the same command system of counties and commanderies. On one side was the new regime established by Wang Mang in 9 CE: the empire was divided into thirteen provinces with commanderies and counties below them, the authority of the provincial governors and the commandery officials overlapping, and the armies pieced together from the picked troops of the commanderies, the frontier garrisons, the tuntian soldiers and the hastily conscripted "troops of all under heaven"; weapons were cast by the government, the crossbow triggers and the arrowheads were provided by each commandery for itself, and grain and provisions were raised by heavier taxation and requisition. The other side was in the beginning not an army at all but the Red Eyebrows, who rose first in the commandery of Tai in 17 CE, in the fourth year of the Tiansfeng era, and then in Langya; their leaders were Fan Jun and Dong Feng, each commanding a detachment leader (qu shuai) and gathering from several thousand to tens of thousands of men, and they took their name from dyeing their eyebrows red as a mark. In the same year Liu Jin, the governor of Runan, Wang Kuang, the governor of the northern commandery of Beihai, and the imperial clansman Liu Xuan also raised troops, answered the Red Eyebrows and were afterwards called together the "Xuan and the Red Eyebrows". From then on the insurgents flew the banner of a Han clansman: Liu Xuan was acclaimed emperor at Wan and changed the era to Gengshi, while the Red Eyebrows set up another clansman, Liu Penzi, as emperor in Guanzhong; the two armies joined and parted in turn and fought repeatedly for the lead. At the same time commanders in the field such as Liu Xiu held their own ground in Hebei, Jingzhou and Nanyang, and gathered refugees and scattered soldiers under the pretext of putting down the disorder, and they became the force that finally destroyed the Red Eyebrows. By 27 CE the main body of the Red Eyebrows had been hunted down and killed by Wu Han at Yiyang and Hucheng, and the remnants broke up in the region of Chenliu and Pei; the disorganisation of the commandery and county system left by the new dynasty, and the military result of its destruction, came down in the end to Liu Xiu's side.
people: 赤眉一方的要角，多是郡吏、鄉里首領與漢室宗親。樊俊、董封是泰山赤眉最初的起事首領，在饑荒最重的泰山、琅邪一帶聚眾成軍，替赤眉打下最初的旗號；琅邪、北海諸郡的起義首領多為地方豪右，事後姓名多不可考。汝南太守劉縉是北方起義的樞紐，他以郡守之資起兵，自居漢室宗親，一度自立為帝，與赤眉聯兵之後把名分讓給劉玄；宗室劉玄後於宛被推為帝，改元更始，成為中原的名義共主，也因此同赤眉爭奪主導權。赤眉在關中另立宗室後裔劉盆子為帝，以為漢統的象徵；劉盆子年少無權，軍政由渠帥們實際掌握，宗室劉恭後來弒盆子以圖降漢。另一面，劉秀自更始政權中的宗室將領升為地方統帥，於昆陽以寡破眾而聲名大振，再經營河北與洛陽，步步坐大。真正負責追滅赤眉的是吳漢、鄧禹、馮異、岑彭、朱祐一系將領：鄧禹先入關中設營屯田，吳漢追至湖城，朱祐在陳留、沛國一線截斷餘眾退路，岑彭則掃清南陽、荊州方面的劉縉殘部。新朝一方的主角自然是王莽，他屢改幣制、行王田與榷酤之制，末年又調發天下兵與死囚，卻始終未能把各地亂源壓住。
peopleEn: The leading figures on the Red Eyebrows side were mostly commandery officials, village headmen and imperial clansmen. Fan Jun and Dong Feng were the first leaders of the Red Eyebrows of Tai, gathering men in the Tai and Langya districts where the famine was worst and giving the movement its first banner; the leaders of the risings in Langya and in Beihai were mostly local great men whose names have not come down to us. Liu Jin, the governor of Runan, was the hinge of the rising in the north: he raised troops with the strength of a commandery governor, claimed to be of the Han imperial clan, proclaimed himself emperor for a time, and after joining with the Red Eyebrows gave the name and title to Liu Xuan. Liu Xuan was then acclaimed emperor at Wan, changed the era to Gengshi, became the nominal common sovereign of the Central Plain, and from that position quarreled with the Red Eyebrows for the leadership. The Red Eyebrows set up another clansman, Liu Penzi, as emperor in Guanzhong as a token of the Han line; Penzi was young and had no power, and the army and the government were in the hands of the detachment leaders, and later the clansman Liu Gong killed Penzi in the hope of surrendering to the Han. On the other side, Liu Xiu rose from being one more clansman general under the Gengshi regime to being a commander in the field, made his name at Kunyang by beating a much larger force, and then built himself up in Hebei and around Luoyang. The men who actually hunted the Red Eyebrows down were Wu Han, Deng Yu, Feng Yi, Cen Peng and Zhu You: Deng Yu entered Guanzhong first and set up camp and tuntian, Wu Han pursued them to Hucheng, Zhu You cut the retreat of the remnants at Chenliu and Pei, and Cen Peng cleared the remaining forces of Liu Jin in Nanyang and Jingzhou. On the other side the central figure was of course Wang Mang, who changed the coinage again and again, enforced the royal fields and the state monopolies, and in his last years conscripted the troops of all under heaven together with the condemned prisoners, yet never managed to put down the sources of disorder.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩，是弩這種兵器在先秦已成熟的樣子：弩機把弦的拉力儲存起來，扣動機括即可釋放，射速遠勝拉弓。考古上，秦代的弩機在湖北雲夢睡虎地秦墓出土，銅質機括與望山一應俱全，秦簡律文亦把弩、矢列入軍器與刑責的條目。漢承秦制，弩成為郡國武庫的標準裝備，弩機仍以銅鑄為主，河北滿城漢墓、長沙馬王堆漢墓等都出過弩機、弓弩與大量鐵鏃；漢廷還曾頒「尚弩令」，以錢財厚賞弩手、令郡國供備弩具，可見弩在東漢已不只是冷兵器，也是國家可以直接調度的軍資。就赤眉這場戰爭而言，弩的意義在兩端：守城一方用弩把攻城者壓在牆外，漢軍與新軍在野戰中也都靠弩陣，東漢文獻記載的「弩陣」講前排跪射、後排承接、依次前進替換的密集射擊之法，正是用弩的機括換來射速與精度。起義軍自身的器械則以冷兵器為主：長矛、戈、戟、環首刀與弓，攻城靠雲梯、撞車、鉤車這類簡陋的飛樓與攻城架，沒有大型投石機，也沒有配重攻城槌；糧食運轉靠繳獲的牛車與關中徵來的車，關中多水，渭水、涇水一線也用船轉輸。馬匹是稀缺品，赤眉入關才大量得馬，故其隊伍以步兵為主、車兵為輔、騎兵極少；新軍則配有甲胄與大量弓弩，據傳世記載其出戰人數以數十萬計，器械配給卻不可能齊一。衣物與糧秣的短缺貫穿赤眉全軍，直到關中大饑，軍中採菱、掘藕以食，這也是他們在宜陽崩潰的直接原因之一。
kitsEn: The Qin crossbow on the card is the form the weapon had already taken in the pre-Qin period: the trigger mechanism stores the strain of the string, and the shot is released by pulling the catch, so that the rate of fire is far higher than that of a drawn bow. Archaeologically, Qin crossbow triggers have been unearthed from the Qin tomb at Shuihudi in Yunmeng, Hubei, complete with their bronze mechanism and their sighting device, and the Qin legal texts themselves list the crossbow and its bolts among military equipment and among the objects for whose loss men were responsible. The Han inherited the Qin system, and the crossbow became standard stock in the armoury of every commandery, its trigger still cast in bronze; the Han tomb at Mancheng in Hebei and the Mawangdui tombs at Changsha in Hunan have both yielded crossbow triggers, bows and crossbows and quantities of iron arrowheads. The Han court even issued the "Shang Nu Ling", ordering that money and goods be given lavishly to crossbowmen and that commanderies and states should furnish crossbows, so that by the Eastern Han the crossbow was no longer merely a hand weapon but a military resource the state could summon directly. For this war the significance of the crossbow lies at both ends: the defenders used it to pin the attackers against the walls, and both the Han armies and the armies of the new dynasty relied on crossbow formations in the field. The "crossbow formation" described in the Eastern Han texts, in which the front rank kneels and shoots, the rank behind receives the spent bolts and the line advances by replacement in turn, is exactly the dense rate of fire bought by the trigger mechanism. The equipment of the insurgents themselves was in the main cold weapons: long spears, ge, ji, ring-pommel swords and bows. For assaults they had the crude siege gear of the time, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and the hook pole, with no great stone-thrower and no weighted ram; grain was moved in captured ox carts and in carts levied in Guanzhong, and since Guanzhong is full of water, the Wei and the Jing were also used for transport by boat. Horses were scarce, and the Red Eyebrows only got hold of large numbers of them after entering Guanzhong, so their order was mainly foot with a little chariot and very little cavalry; the armies of the new dynasty, on the other hand, were equipped with armour and with bows and crossbows in bulk, and the transmitted accounts put the size of their field force at tens of thousands of men, though their equipment cannot possibly have been uniform. Shortage of clothing and of provisions ran through the whole Red Eyebrows army, right to the great famine in Guanzhong, when the troops ate water caltrop and dug lotus roots for food; this too was one of the direct reasons for their collapse at Yiyang.
tactics: 赤眉軍的戰術起於饑荒，長於流竄而非攻城。起義初期是典型的蜂起：泰山、琅邪、汝南、北海各地各自聚眾，人數多而器械少，沒有統一旗號與編制，靠的是郡吏反正、鄉里響應與流民湧入形成的滾雪球。與劉縉、劉玄聯兵後，局面才有變化：劉玄兵入洛陽、進取關中，赤眉則在東線與北線打遊擊，把流民、潰兵與繳獲的器械沿途收編，人數滾到數十萬，於是車兵、糧車與連營成為軍隊的骨架，營壘沿道排開、動則一日數十里，靠人海與速度彌補裝備的不足。攻城時赤眉仍取笨法：積芻蒿、填攻道、築土山以逼近城牆，用撞車與鈎竿破門，雲梯同時上人；入洛陽、入長安之後更放火焚燒宮室市里，一方面逼官軍放棄守城，另一方面把糧秣一把火燒掉，令占城的一方自己受飢。漢軍這邊完全是另一路：以逸待勞、守城待敵，劉秀在昆陽以少擊多之後，深知流寇的弱點是缺乏器械與攻堅能力，遂採長驅追擊與斷糧相配合的辦法；鄧禹、吳漢、馮異率輕騎疾進，吳漢在宜陽追上赤眉，先以弩陣與突騎擾其行列，再趁其退路被斷、士氣崩潰時全線出擊，把赤眉逼入湖城一帶的河谷，然後焚其車重、斷其糧道，收其降卒。餘眾東走陳留、沛國一線，再遭朱祐等部截擊，最終全軍潰散。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Red Eyebrows grew out of famine and were strong in movement, not in siege. The opening phase was a typical rising of bees: in Tai, Langya, Runan and Beihai men gathered separately, numerous but short of equipment, without a common banner or a common establishment, and what carried them was the turn of commandery officials, the answering of village and neighbourhood and the inflow of refugees, a snowball that rolled and grew. Only after joining with Liu Jin and Liu Xuan did the situation change. Liu Xuan's troops entered Luoyang and pressed on into Guanzhong, while the Red Eyebrows struck in the east and the north, gathering on the way refugees, routed soldiers and captured weapons; their numbers rolled up into the tens of thousands, so that chariots, supply carts and a chain of camps became the skeleton of the army, the encampments strung out along the road and the column moving tens of li a day, making up for the shortage of equipment with numbers and speed. In assault the Red Eyebrows still used crude methods: they piled up brushwood, filled in the approach, built earthen ramps against the walls, used battering rams and hook poles to break the gates while scaling ladders went up together; and after entering Luoyang and Chang'an they set fire to palaces and market wards, partly to force the government troops to abandon the city, partly to burn the stores so that the side that seized the city would itself go hungry. The Han armies followed a completely different way. They waited at ease, held their cities and let the enemy come: after Kunyang, where Liu Xiu beat a much larger force with a few, he knew well that the weakness of such bands lay in their lack of equipment and of siege power, and so he used the long pursuit combined with cutting of supplies. Deng Yu, Wu Han and Feng Yi led light cavalry forward fast; Wu Han caught the Red Eyebrows at Yiyang, harried their ranks with the crossbow formation and sudden cavalry charges, and then, when their retreat was cut and their morale broke, struck along the whole line and drove them into the river country about Hucheng, where he burned their wagons, cut their grain road and took their surrendered men. The remnants went east toward Chenliu and Pei, were intercepted on the way by the troops of Zhu You and others, and the whole force came apart.
data: 可核對的數字分三類。其一是年表：起事繫於公元17年（天鳳四年）秋，泰山赤眉先起，汝南、北海同年響應；公元18年劉玄入洛陽；公元23年劉玄入長安、王莽敗死，新朝覆亡；公元25年赤眉立劉盆子為帝、率眾入關，同年更始帝劉玄在淯陽被殺；公元26年劉秀定都洛陽，鄧禹率軍入關追擊；公元27年赤眉主力在宜陽被破，十餘萬眾降，其餘東走，至同年被漢軍各部追平。兵力方面，傳世記載多以概數出之：赤眉眾由起事初期的數十萬說到宜陽戰前的「百萬之眾」，新莽一方在昆陽所集之軍記為四十餘萬，劉秀自述當時所部不過數千；宜陽一役的斬獲與降卒，記載有萬餘級、十餘萬眾、二十餘萬眾諸說，多為約數，不宜當作確數。人口方面，漢平帝元始二年（公元2年）版籍載戶一千二百二十三萬餘、口五千九百六十萬，這是漢代最後一次較完整的統計，此後經戰亂、疫癘與流亡，官方戶籍數十載不得復原。距離上，泰山至長安直線約一千一百公里，實際行程因繞潼關、渡黃河而更遠，故赤眉自山東入關多走一個多月。器物方面，弩的有效射程一般以百步上下估算，強弩可及更遠，漢軍與新軍的弩陣都依賴這樣的射程去覆蓋攻城者；漢墓出土的弩機與箭鏃數量，可與上述兵力的量級互相印證。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes. The first is the chronology. The rising is dated to the autumn of 17 CE, the fourth year of the Tiansfeng era, when the Red Eyebrows of Tai rose first and Runan and Beihai answered in the same year; in 18 CE Liu Xuan entered Luoyang; in 23 CE Liu Xuan entered Chang'an, Wang Mang was killed, and the new dynasty came to an end; in 25 CE the Red Eyebrows set up Liu Penzi as emperor and led their people into Guanzhong, and in the same year the Gengshi emperor Liu Xuan was killed at Yuyang; in 26 CE Liu Xiu fixed his capital at Luoyang and Deng Yu led troops into Guanzhong in pursuit; in 27 CE the main body of the Red Eyebrows was broken at Yiyang and more than a hundred thousand men surrendered, while the rest went east and was hunted down that same year by the several Han columns. As for numbers of troops, the transmitted accounts are mostly general figures: the Red Eyebrows are given as tens of thousands at the start of the rising and as a "host of a million" before the fighting at Yiyang; the army the new dynasty gathered at Kunyang is put at more than four hundred thousand, while Liu Xiu said the force under him at that moment was no more than a few thousand; and for the killed and surrendered at Yiyang the records give several scores of thousands, a hundred thousand and more, two hundred thousand and more, all of them approximations that should not be taken as exact. As for population, the register of the second year of Yuanshi (2 CE) under Emperor Ping of Han records some 12,230,000 households and 59,600,000 mouths; this is the last fairly complete count of the Han, and after the wars, the epidemics and the flight of the people the official registers were not restored for decades. As for distance, the direct line from Tai to Chang'an is about 1,100 kilometres, and the actual march was longer because of the detour round the Tong Pass and the crossing of the Yellow River, which is why the Red Eyebrows took more than a month to go from Shandong into Guanzhong. As for equipment, the effective range of the crossbow is generally estimated at something like a hundred paces, with the stronger engines reaching further, and the crossbow formations of both the Han and the new dynasty depended on a range of that order to cover the attackers; the numbers of crossbow triggers and arrowheads recovered from Han tombs can be checked against the order of magnitude of those forces.
cause: 赤眉軍起義的根子不在一次偶然的失政，而在王莽建新之後把整個帝國的財政、土地與兵制同時推倒重來。第一是土地：王莽行王田制，把天下田改稱王田、禁止買賣，想用托古的井田制取代土地兼併，但當時戶口稠密、荒地難得，政策一紙推行就同地方豪強和農戶同時衝突。第二是財政與物價：多次重鑄錢幣、禁絕民間鑄錢，又以五均六筦壟斷鹽、鐵、酒、釀與錢，並放貸收息，錢重物輕、穀價飛漲，農民賣田賣子仍繳不上賦。第三是水旱與蝗災：公元11年前後黃河改道，冀州、兗州、豫州一片汪洋，堤防工程又抽丁萬計，饑荒蔓延到青、徐、荊，饑民扶老攜幼流亡，在路上成軍。第四是吏治與兵制：新朝把州牧、太守、大司農的權力混在一起，命令層層加碼，郡縣胥吏趁災加派，貪污無從禁絕；而常備軍被抽去修渠、築城、出征西域、備匈奴，邊防與內地同時空虛，於是地方一旦有人舉旗，官軍不是無兵就是無糧，鎮壓反而把更多饑民推入起義軍。第五是人心與合法性：王莽靠符命與祥瑞奪位，又禁用漢制、改易服色、屢易年號，反而令熟悉漢室的鄉里視新朝為篡奪之政，劉縉、劉玄打出漢室旗號時，山東、河南的響應格外迅速。赤眉以「赤眉」為號，說明它起於鄉里自發而非朝廷陰謀，也說明它要的從一開始就只是活命，而王莽的新秩序給不了他們活命的辦法。
causeEn: The root of the Red Eyebrows rising lay not in a single accidental failure of government but in the fact that after founding the new dynasty Wang Mang overturned the finance, the land and the military system of the empire all at once. First, the land. Wang Mang enforced the royal fields, renamed the fields of the world as the king's fields and forbade their sale, in the attempt to replace land accumulation with a restored well-field system; but the population was dense and good land was scarce, and the policy as soon as it was published collided with the local great men and with the peasants at the same time. Second, finance and prices. Money was recast again and again, private minting was forbidden, and through the five controls and six monopolies the state took the salt, the iron, the wine, the brewing and the money into its own hands while lending out interest; coin was heavy and goods were cheap, prices of grain ran away, and peasants who sold their fields and their children still could not pay their dues. Third, water, drought and locusts. Around 11 CE the Yellow River changed its course and the Yi, Yan and Yu prefectures became a stretch of open water; the works on the dikes took tens of thousands of labourers, and the famine spread to Qing, Xu and Jing, so that the hungry left with their old and their young and became troops on the road. Fourth, the officials and the armies. The new dynasty mixed up the powers of the provincial governors, the commandery governors and the minister of agriculture, so that orders piled up layer by layer and the clerks of the commanderies levied the extra while famine was on, with no end to their corruption; and the standing army was drawn off to dig channels, build walls, campaign in the western regions and hold the Xiongnu, leaving the frontier and the interior alike empty, so that whenever a district raised a banner the government troops were either without men or without grain, and the repression pushed still more hungry people into the insurgents. Fifth, hearts and legitimacy. Wang Mang had taken the throne by talismans and auspicious portents, then forbade the Han institutions, changed the dress and changed the era names again and again, so that the villages, long accustomed to the Han, came to see the new dynasty as a usurpation; and when Liu Jin and Liu Xuan flew the banner of the Han clan, the response in Shandong and in Henan was unusually quick. The Red Eyebrows took their name from red eyebrows, which shows that they rose of their own accord in the villages and not by the contrivance of a court, and equally shows that what they wanted from the first was simply to stay alive, which was a thing the new order of Wang Mang could not give them.
impact: 赤眉軍起義的影響，首先是加速了新朝的崩潰。赤眉與劉玄、劉縉聯兵後兵鋒直指洛陽、長安，公元18年入洛陽、公元23年入長安，王莽在谷城被殺，新朝十三年而亡；其中赤眉出力最狠，因為它把流民直接變成了可以填城、能扛攻的軍隊。其次是把關中打成一片廢墟：赤眉入關後連營數百里，日耗糧秣，關中本已因水災缺糧，軍隊與流民爭食，盜賊蜂起，饑荒一直延到東漢初年；為平叛而屯田、括戶、移民，東漢政府在此花掉的力氣遠勝於打赤眉本身。第三是改變了東漢的權力結構：劉秀憑藉平定赤眉、昆陽與河北之功收攏兵權與糧道，於是更始政權瓦解之後，漢室的旗號不再只靠劉縉、劉玄一系，劉秀另起爐竈，於鄗稱帝、定都洛陽，赤眉留下的地盤與降卒成了新朝的兵源。第四是社會結構的破壞與恢復：長久的戰亂使戶籍散亂、流民遍野，戰後重建鄉里、括民為戶、復舊賦役，是東漢建國頭十年的頭等大事。第五在技術層面：秦弩這類器械經東漢的實戰檢驗後繼續改良，銅弩機的形制在兩漢出土品中被不斷精修，弩與弓並列的遠射體系維持到魏晉，而漢末的混戰最終催生了諸葛連弩與板臂弩一類更強的機括。
impactEn: The effect of the Red Eyebrows rising was first to hasten the collapse of the new dynasty. After joining with Liu Xuan and Liu Jin, the Red Eyebrows drove straight for Luoyang and Chang'an, entering Luoyang in 18 CE and Chang'an in 23, when Wang Mang was killed at Gucheng and the new dynasty ended after thirteen years; and the Red Eyebrows bore the hardest part of this, because they turned the refugees at once into men who could fill a city wall and bear an assault. Second, they turned Guanzhong into a ruin. After entering the pass the Red Eyebrows chained their camps for hundreds of li and consumed provisions daily, and Guanzhong was already short of grain from the floods; the army and the refugees fought over the same food, robbery rose everywhere, and the famine ran on into the first years of the Eastern Han, so that the work of the new government here, in opening tuntian, in registering households and in moving people, cost it far more than the beating of the Red Eyebrows had. Third, it changed the shape of power in the Eastern Han. On the strength of putting down the Red Eyebrows, of Kunyang and of his years in Hebei, Liu Xiu gathered the command of the troops and the grain roads into his own hands, so that when the Gengshi regime fell apart the banner of the Han no longer rested on the line of Liu Jin and Liu Xuan alone; Liu Xiu set up on his own, was acclaimed emperor at Hao, fixed his capital at Luoyang, and the ground and the surrendered men left by the Red Eyebrows became the manpower of the new dynasty. Fourth, the social structure was broken and had to be rebuilt. Long war scattered the registers and filled the roads with refugees, so that the reorganisation of the villages, the registering of the people and the restoration of the old levies were the first business of the first ten years of the Eastern Han. Fifth, on the technical level, weapons such as the Qin crossbow went on being improved after their trial in Eastern Han warfare, the form of the bronze trigger was refined again and again in the two Han periods, the system in which crossbow and bow stood side by side as the missile weapons of the army held on into Wei and Jin, and the wars of the late Han at last brought forth stronger mechanisms in the repeating crossbow and in the drawn arm crossbow.
result: 公元27年，戰局在宜陽與湖城一線定下來。赤眉主力與漢軍在宜陽相持，吳漢率騎兵與弩手趨上，擊破其前鋒，又追至湖城，焚其車重、斷其糧道，十餘萬眾走投無路，於是紛紛放下兵器。餘部帶著劉盆子東走陳留、沛國，漢將朱祐等部截擊於中途，兵眾再散，劉盆子與宗室劉恭先後出降，劉恭弒盆子以獻，餘眾或降或散入山澤。與此同時，南陽、荊州的劉縉勢力也被岑彭、吳漢等平定，新莽時代留下的最後一支大軍就此瓦解。赤眉作為一支起於饑民的聯軍，完成了它的歷史任務：它把新朝打垮，把流民送上了關中的道路，也把關中變成一片需要重新收拾的荒地。東漢得以在洛陽立國，很大程度上是踩著赤眉的殘骸起家；但真正決定結局的不是赤眉的失敗，而是劉秀一方在糧道、屯田與賞罰上的制度能力——赤眉有十萬之眾而無一日之糧，漢軍兵少卻能遠出追擊，兩者在同一片關中土地上的差距，最後落在了糧食上。
resultEn: In 27 CE the issue was settled on the line of Yiyang and Hucheng. The main body of the Red Eyebrows and the Han troops stood opposed at Yiyang, where Wu Han came up with cavalry and crossbowmen, broke their advance and pursued them to Hucheng, burned their wagons, cut their grain road, and left a hundred thousand men with no way out, so that they laid down their arms. The remnants, with Liu Penzi among them, went east toward Chenliu and Pei, were intercepted on the way by the troops of Zhu You and others and came apart again; Penzi and the clansman Liu Gong surrendered in turn, Gong killed Penzi to offer him up, and the rest either surrendered or scattered into the hills. At the same time the forces of Liu Jin in Nanyang and Jingzhou were settled by Cen Peng, Wu Han and others, and the last great army of the age of the new dynasty was thereby broken up. As a coalition that had risen out of hunger, the Red Eyebrows accomplished their historical work: they brought the new dynasty down, they carried the refugees onto the road into Guanzhong, and they left Guanzhong a stretch of wasteland that had to be put in order again. The Eastern Han was able to establish itself at Luoyang to a very large extent by standing on the wreckage of the Red Eyebrows; but what really decided the outcome was not the defeat of the Red Eyebrows but the institutional capacity of Liu Xiu's side in grain roads, tuntian and reward and punishment. The Red Eyebrows had a hundred thousand men and not one day's food; the Han army was few and could yet march out far to pursue them; the difference between the two sides on the same soil of Guanzhong came down in the end to grain.
